_comment: Whatever burns, burning as hard as it can. `glow` is one name on the stars, the curtain and the
bow, so this is the same word about all three and about anything that grows a glow later.
It was `brilliant` and the aurora's alone. Once the three glows shared a name the word was already
reaching all of them, so what was left was a name that did not say so (Jonah, 2026-08-31).
